turns.prompt: The apprentice at Bellhouse Marine Electrical asked what the drop column on a cable schedule means; the figure is the loss in millivolts for every ampere the cable carries over each metre of the run. Circuit BK-7 is a two-core 2.5 square millimetre run of 38 metres that will carry 17 amperes. Give the drop along that run, in volts. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
